title: WindscreenWiper
description: Schema for windscreen wiper sensor data. The value represents the the active status of the windscreen wipers

eventTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC (must end with 'Z'), indicating when the measurement was taken

traceId.description: Unique identifier for tracing this message

messageNumber.description: Sequence number, increased by one for each new message

sensorId.description: Unique identifier for the sensor. Typically the serial number (S/N) from the sensor.

value.description: Indicating weather the windscreen wiper is active
